block.projectexa.stone_table.tooltip: Transmute items using personal knowledge and EMC.
gui.projectexa.stone_table.cant_use: This item is not allowed by the current whitelist.
item.projectexa.personal_emc_warehouse.t: Uses the bound account's knowledge and EMC as an inventory for tools, guns, and other items.
Right-click to open; sneak-right-click to bind or rebind it to yourself. Any holder can use it.
Put it in a Touhou Little Maid inventory or equip it in a Curios slot to supply ammo for TACZ guns.
item.projectexa.personal_emc_warehouse.u: Unbound; right-click to bind it to yourself and open it
item.projectexa.personal_emc_warehouse.i: Only EMC-valued items learned by the bound account can be set; the account must be online.
advancements.projectexa.personal_emc_war: Let any holder's tools draw items from the bound account's personal EMC.
